title.narrative: Apoyo estratégico para el desarrollo rural de occidente

description.narrative:
The project promotes a profound transformation in rural communities in western Guatemala by substantially improving the living conditions of rights-holders by strengthening their productive, organizational and participatory capacities, allowing them to fully exercise their Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights (ESCER) and expand food security and sovereignty with access to adequate and sustainable food.
Through the equitable consolidation of the Total Community Participation model, unity, local governance and collective leadership are strengthened, promoting solid, transparent and influential civil society organizations. Sustainable livelihoods are generated through the development of entrepreneurial skills, community entrepreneurship, financial education and integration into markets, boosting the rural economy and increasing family incomes.
With a focus on climate justice, harmonious coexistence with nature is recovered through conservation practices, responsible management of water resources and renewable technologies, increasing resilience and the capacity for adaptation and mitigation in the face of climate change.
From a transformative gender perspective, the equitable participation and leadership of women and youth is promoted, breaking patriarchal norms, fostering economic autonomy and moving towards co-responsibility in care, consolidating fairer, more prosperous, resilient and sovereign communities.
